purpose: Connect the principal property-registration pathways into one date-aware evidence-driven lifecycle while keeping each legal event distinct.
composition_rules: Classify the property and registration status before selecting an event pathway.
One real-world event may trigger multiple legal and administrative pathways.
Registration status, substantive title, beneficial ownership, security interests and property rights remain distinct layers.
Historical events must be analysed under the law and registration rules applicable at the relevant date.
A later register entry does not automatically erase the historical legal state.
Official-record evidence is required before property-specific facts are asserted.
guardrails: No single registry record is treated as the complete legal history.
No current ownership conclusion without current authoritative evidence.
No historical conclusion without date-aware source analysis.
No silent merging of title, beneficial interest, mortgage, easement or dispute status.
No property-specific publication without an evidence chain.
